mapper.select: SELECT lib_code, isbn13, status, fetched_at FROM book_call_number WHERE lib_code = #{libCode} AND isbn13 = #{isbn13}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_call_number ( lib_code, isbn13, status ) VALUES ( #{libCode}, #{isbn13}, #{status} ) ON CONFLICT (lib_code, isbn13) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, fetched_at = now()

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM book_call_number_item WHERE lib_code = #{libCode} AND isbn13 = #{isbn13}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO book_call_number_item ( lib_code, isbn13, seq, class_no, book_code, separate_shelf_name, shelf_loc_name, copy_count, latest_reg_date ) VALUES
( #{i.libCode}, #{i.isbn13}, #{i.seq}, #{i.classNo}, #{i.bookCode}, #{i.separateShelfName}, #{i.shelfLocName}, #{i.copyCount}, #{i.latestRegDate} )
mapper.select:
select region_code, dtl_region_code from holding_region WHERE isbn13 = #{isbn13} AND fetched_at > now() - INTERVAL '1 day' AND (region_code, dtl_region_code) IN
(#{r.regionCode}, #{r.dtlRegionCode})

select lib_code from holding_library where isbn13 = #{isbn13} AND (region_code, dtl_region_code) IN
(#{region.regionCode}, #{region.dtlRegionCode})
mapper.insert:
insert into holding_library ( isbn13, lib_code, region_code, dtl_region_code ) values
( #{i.isbn13}, #{i.libCode}, #{i.regionCode}, #{i.dtlRegionCode} )
ON CONFLICT (isbn13, lib_code) DO UPDATE SET region_code = EXCLUDED.region_code, dtl_region_code = EXCLUDED.dtl_region_code, fetched_at = now()

insert into holding_region ( isbn13, region_code, dtl_region_code ) values ( #{isbn13}, #{region.regionCode}, #{region.dtlRegionCode} ) ON CONFLICT (isbn13, region_code, dtl_region_code) DO UPDATE SET fetched_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT region_code, dtl_region_code FROM library WHERE location IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin( location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326)::geography, #{radius} ) GROUP BY region_code, dtl_region_code ORDER BY MIN( ST_Distance( location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326)::geography ) ) ASC
